capabilities: apply text-only or background highlights in nine theme-aware colors
change or remove highlights across any selected range, including mixed lines
insert bg- prefixed extensions of Obsidian's ==highlight== syntax
register commands for Editing Toolbar menus and one-click color buttons
work alongside Clear formatting and Editing Toolbar's Clear Text Formatting
extras: The README opens with a caution that this is an unmaintained, vibe-coded prototype and users should keep backups. It also includes developer-only sections for exporting the plugin and building a release ZIP on Windows.
intentEvidence: ezHighlighter splits Obsidian's existing Format → Highlight context-menu item into two simple, theme-aware choices
problem: Obsidian's Format → Highlight offers a single background style with no color choice, and its ==text== syntax cannot encode color.

relations.evidence: ezHighlighter registers standard Obsidian commands, so no direct dependency on Editing Toolbar is required.

summary: Highlighter that colors only the selected text or its background, using theme-aware colors and extended ==highlight== Markdown syntax.
